# download_file { #wass2s.download_file }

```python
download_file(
    url,
    local_path,
    force_download=False,
    chunk_size=8192,
    timeout=120,
)
```

Download a file from a URL to a local path with progress tracking.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name           | Type                | Description                                                    | Default    |
|----------------|---------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| url            | str                 | URL of the file to download.                                   | _required_ |
| local_path     | str or pathlib.Path | Local path where the file will be saved.                       | _required_ |
| force_download | bool                | If True, overwrite existing file (default is False).           | `False`    |
| chunk_size     | int                 | Size of chunks for streaming download (default is 8192 bytes). | `8192`     |
| timeout        | int                 | Timeout for the HTTP request in seconds (default is 120).      | `120`      |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                 | Description                                             |
|--------|----------------------|---------------------------------------------------------|
|        | pathlib.Path or None | Path to the downloaded file, or None if download fails. |

## Notes {.doc-section .doc-section-notes}

Skips download if the file already exists and `force_download` is False.
